facts.text: The hotel has ski-in/ski-out access to Vail Mountain from Chair 20, steps from its doors.
facts.excerpt: the best ski‑in/ski‑out access to Vail Mountain from Chair 20, just steps from our doors

facts.text: The resort sits at the base of Vail Mountain alongside Gore Creek.
facts.excerpt: With a captivating backdrop at the base of Vail Mountain alongside Gore Creek

facts.text: In summer a tree-lined path along Gore Creek leads to Vail and Lionshead Villages for walking or biking.
facts.excerpt: In summer, enjoy the tree-lined path along Gore Creek to walk or bike to Vail and Lionshead Villages

facts.text: The resort has a heated creek-side infinity pool with two hot tubs.
facts.excerpt: from our heated creek‑side infinity pool, complete with two hot tubs

facts.text: The outdoor pool is a saline pool with lounge chairs and rental cabanas.
facts.excerpt: The outdoor saline pool at our Vail resort also offers spacious lounge chairs and rental cabanas

facts.text: Cold plunges and saunas are on the pool deck.
facts.excerpt: A peaceful alpine spot on the pool deck invites guests to unwind in cold plunges and saunas

facts.text: The spa takes inspiration from traditional alpine spas.
facts.excerpt: The Spa at Grand Hyatt Vail Resort and Spa takes inspiration from traditional alpine spas

facts.text: The spa uses products from Hydrafacial, HydroPeptide and Comfort Zone, plus local products such as Phia and Lost Range.
facts.excerpt: We use premium moisturizing products from hydrafacial, HydroPeptide and Comfort Zone, as well as the best local products like Phia and Lost Range.

facts.text: The signature Alpine Transformation Wrap combines a body peel, a mud and micro-algae wrap and a full body massage.
facts.excerpt: Beginning with a gentle body peel, followed by a mud and micro-algae wrap and finished with a full body massage

facts.text: Many rooms and suites have private balconies overlooking Gore Creek and the western slopes of Vail Mountain, paired with fireplaces.
facts.excerpt: Many of our rooms and suites offer private balconies overlooking Gore Creek and the western slopes of Vail Mountain and are paired with fireplaces

facts.text: The Blue Sky Presidential Two-Bedroom Suite has a double-sided fireplace, a dining area for eight, private balconies and a copper soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Discover refined mountain luxury in this two-bedroom suite featuring a spacious living room, double-sided fireplace, dining area for eight, and private balconies. The two bathrooms offer a copper soaking tub

facts.text: The Vail Residences at Cascade Village range from one-bedroom condominiums to nine-bedroom homes, with full use of the resort amenities.
facts.excerpt: Discover our residences ranging from one‑bedroom condominiums to expansive nine‑bedroom homes.

facts.text: Some rooms and suites are designed for families with bunk beds.
facts.excerpt: thoughtfully designed for families and featuring a king bed and bunk beds

facts.text: Family amenities include an arcade and movie nights in the Grand Theater.
facts.excerpt: From games in the hotel arcade to movie nights in the Grand Theater

facts.text: Topgolf Swing Suites offer virtual golf, soccer, baseball and kids games in a private suite with food and drink service for up to 12 guests.
facts.excerpt: enjoy virtual soccer, baseball, kids games and more in a private suite with food and drink service for up to 12 guests

facts.text: Venture Sports on the first floor offers ski concierge, valet, overnight tuning and premium ski and snowboard rentals.
facts.excerpt: Venture Sports, located on the first floor of Grand Hyatt Vail Resort and Spa, offers ski concierge, valet service, overnight tuning, and premium equipment rentals for skiers and snowboarders

facts.text: The hotel has a Vail Resorts ticket office for lift tickets.
facts.excerpt: Offering a Vail Resorts ticket office for your last-minute lift ticket

facts.text: Chair 20 is open on select dates during the winter season; early or late season operation should be confirmed with the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Chair 20 is open select dates during the winter season - contact our hotel to confirm early or late season operations.

facts.text: Makoto Vail serves contemporary Japanese cuisine by Chef Makoto Okuwa, including sushi, sashimi, Wagyu beef and Japanese spirits and sake.
facts.excerpt: From bright sushi platters and the freshest sashimi to a decadent selection of Wagyu beef, creatively unique desserts, and a breathtaking selection of specialty Japanese spirits and sake

facts.text: Gessner Colorado Mountain Grill, named after the Swiss natural historian, blends Rocky Mountain flavors with the European influence of Vail Valley.
facts.excerpt: Named after the Swiss natural historian, Gessner blends Rocky Mountain flavors with the European influence of Vail Valley

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours and overlooks the outdoor infinity pool along Gore Creek.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the outdoor infinity pool along Gore creek, our 24/7 fitness center promotes health and wellbeing for our guests.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Your dogs are welcome at Grand Hyatt Vail Resort and Spa

facts.text: Vail and Lionshead Villages are about 1 mile, a 5-minute drive, from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Located only 1 mile and a short 5-minute drive from the resort

facts.text: Eagle County Regional Airport is 34 miles away.
